name: pycharm-attach
description: Attach the Python debugger to an already-running process from a picker. No launch.json: set breakpoints, run your script anywhere (terminal, SSH), pick it, debug.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Debug a script that is already running, no launch.json needed:
[$(plug) Attach to Running Python Process](command:attach.pickProcess)
Set your breakpoints, run the script from any terminal or SSH session, then pick it here.

attach.justMyCode.description: Pass justMyCode to debugpy. Set to false to step into library and framework code.

attach.processFilter.description: Regular expression applied to the full command line. Only matching Python processes are listed (empty = list all of yours).

attach.showHiddenProcesses.description: Also list editor tooling (debugpy adapters, VS Code Server helpers, language servers). You can toggle this from the picker too.

attach.defaultHost.description: Default host for 'Connect to Listening debugpy'.

attach.defaultPort.description: Default port for 'Connect to Listening debugpy' and for the copied launch command.

attach.pathMappings.description: Optional debugpy pathMappings ({localRoot, remoteRoot}) added to every attach. Not needed for Remote-SSH, where the extension runs on the server.

attach.subProcess.description: Pass subProcess to debugpy so child processes spawned after attaching are debugged too.

attach.extraConfig.description: Extra keys merged into the generated debug configuration (escape hatch, e.g. {"logToFile": true}).

attach.showStatusBarItem.description: Show the 'Attach' button in the status bar.

attach.verboseLogging.description: Log every process considered by the picker (and why it was hidden) to the Output channel.
